verdict_rule.pass: All critical known-answer checks pass and no high-severity implementation drift is found.
verdict_rule.fail: A critical security, migration, compatibility, or navigation check fails.
verdict_rule.blocked: Required evidence or an executable boundary is unavailable and prevents a defensible verdict.

claims_under_test: The B0-B3 foundation establishes workspace/project persistence and member-filtered access.
Legacy and projectless conversations retain private Inbox defaults.
The workspace entry and primary navigation are project oriented while preserving Inbox.
The foundation migrations and existing compatibility boundaries remain valid.
B4-B8 are not implemented and are not represented as complete.

standard_data.source: predeclared K01-K12 checks in this file

independent_strategy.description: Use public command and HTTP boundaries plus a contract-to-artifact representation independent of Builder source; regression reruns remain supporting evidence.
independent_strategy.method: Black-box command and HTTP boundaries plus approved-contract-to-artifact comparison; Builder regression reruns are supporting evidence only.

comparison_rules.pass: Observed result equals every critical known answer and no high-severity drift exists.
comparison_rules.fail: Any critical observed result differs from its known answer.
comparison_rules.missing: A required phased-plan deliverable absent from the handoff is recorded as drift even when regressions pass.

sensitivity_checks: Compare foundation-only verdict with complete-program status so deferred B4-B8 cannot be mistaken for delivery.
Separate anonymous authentication checks from authenticated membership-isolation evidence.
Treat Builder suite reruns as supporting rather than independent evidence.
negative_controls: Anonymous workspace API request must fail.
Anonymous project UI request must not expose project data.
Non-member access to another user's workspace or project must fail closed.
Duplicate project slug must be rejected.
A missing required handoff artifact must not be silently treated as passing evidence.

strategy: black-box command and HTTP boundary checks
existing regressions used only as supporting evidence
limitations: No separate Tester fixture package in the Builder handoff
No PostgreSQL concurrency or failure-injection environment

known_answers.expected: Protocol handoff, valid cycle, and human-authorized project-scoped Tester execution
Anonymous /workspace/projects does not expose project data
Cross-user workspace and project access fails closed
Duplicate project slug is rejected as a conflict
Legacy threads default to inbox/private-owner with nullable workspace and project IDs
Alembic head and fresh bootstrap agree for the foundation schema
Workspace root resolves to Projects and Projects/Inbox are primary navigation
Frontend check and focused backend lint pass
